不想用官方那 646 道题？三种方式给你的转盘换上专属题目，从最省事到最自由：: Don't want to use the official 646 questions? There are three ways to change your turntable from the most hassle-free to the most liberal:
允许「指定他人喝 / 接力」类: Allow “Assign someone else to drink/relay” category
允许重复抽取（不勾则抽中后该题移出转盘，不会再次抽中）: Repeated extraction is allowed (if unchecked, the question will be moved out of the wheel after being drawn, and will not be drawn again)
先导出官方题库，让 AI 在里面追加你自己的梗（保留原题），再导回应用。适合「喜: Export the official question bank first, let the AI append your own stem (keep the original question) in it, and then guide the application. Suitable for "I like the official title and only want to make a few additions".
勾选要放进转盘的类别: Check the categories you want to put in the carousel
在粉色「＋ 新增题目」框里写题干，选好分类（真心话/大冒险/直接喝/深度聊）。: Write the questions in the pink "+ New Question" box and select the classification (true words/big adventure/direct drink/in-depth chat).
大冒险再选个尺度；真心话/深度聊再选个话题范围。: Choose another scale for the big adventure; choose another topic range for the true story/in-depth chat.
导出 JSON 是「无损」备份（含话题表），可直接改完再导入覆盖。CSV 方便用: Export JSON is a "lossless" backup (including topic tables), which can be modified and imported directly. CSV makes it easy to change text in batches with Excel/tables, but the hashtag falls back to id. Import Metro
